sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.notes: Mirror ingest done for isPublicDomain objects whose original is 3.3 MB or smaller (many originals exceed 8 MB and are skipped). The retired /v1/search endpoint was replaced by /v1.1/search. Bot protection answered 403 after a burst of about 150 requests; the script paces requests and waits on 403.

sources.name: Wellcome Collection (catalogue API + IIIF)
sources.rightsMode: per-image licence from the catalogue record: only cc-0 and pdm (Public Domain Mark); CC BY and others are never taken
sources.imageMode: selective-mirror (IIIF, long edge capped at 2400 px)
sources.notes: 721 CC0/PDM results for "poster" alone; mostly health, folk and print ephemera.

sources.name: National Gallery of Art Open Data
sources.rightsMode: CSV is CC0; images only where the published image row is open access
sources.notes: Deferred. published_images.csv is 89 MB and has no per-image rights column; the repository README states a general open access policy only. Needs a per-image rights source before mirroring.

sources.notes: A probe timed out once at 25 s and passed on the next run (12.5 s earlier); the API is slow, not blocked.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access (public S3 bucket)
sources.rightsMode: record AND image both flagged CC0 (metadata_usage.access and media usage.access)
sources.imageMode: selective-mirror (ids.si.edu delivery service, long edge capped at 2400 px)
sources.notes: 36 units of 256 shards each (about 1 MB of JSON lines per shard). A fixed sample of shards per unit keeps downloads bounded; units used: Cooper Hewitt, American History, American Art, Freer|Sackler. ids.si.edu sets a cookie, so images are fetched server-side only.

sources.name: Standard Ebooks
sources.rightsMode: per-book content.opf rights statement must be the standard one (US public domain artwork, CC0 contributions)
sources.notes: Book list read from the standardebooks GitHub organisation (1,541 repos); 109 covers from 59 curated authors, long edge capped at 2100 px.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library (posters)
sources.rightsMode: NASA media usage guidelines: content generally not subject to copyright in the US; credit NASA, never imply endorsement
sources.notes: Only items whose own title says poster. The JPL "Visions of the Future" gallery posters are not in this library (0 hits) and the JPL image-policy page answers CloudFront 403 to scripts, so that gallery stays link-only.

sources.name: Minneapolis Institute of Art (search.artsmia.org)
sources.notes: Search works and lists large public-domain items (up to 4699x7135), but the IIIF and CDN image hosts (iiif.dx.artsmia.org, cdn.dx.artsmia.org, api.artsmia.org) do not resolve from the ingest machine; only a 56 KB thumbnail host answers. Retry from CI or another network.

sources.name: Internet Archive advanced search
sources.rightsMode: per-item licenseurl; values are mixed (CC BY, CC BY-SA, PD mark ...), so each item needs its own check
sources.notes: API works (1.15 million items carry a licenseurl). Deferred: licences are too heterogeneous for a bulk filter.

sources.name: Rijksmuseum data service, Getty, Yale, Finnish National Gallery, Nationalmuseum
sources.rightsMode: CC0 / open access on the publishers' own terms
sources.notes: Probed 2026-10-22: Rijksmuseum closed the connection, Getty and Nationalmuseum returned 404, Yale did not resolve, Finnish National Gallery returned 404. Re-probe from another network before building adapters.

sources.name: Kenney CC0 asset packs
sources.notes: Game-asset art, not publisher cover art. Low priority.

sources.name: OpenMoji
sources.notes: Icons, not posters. Low priority.

sources.name: Simple Icons
sources.rightsMode: CC0 collection; brand trademarks still apply
sources.notes: Brand logos imply affiliation; not an artwork source.

sources.name: libretro-database (Redump DAT titles)
sources.rightsMode: metadata only; used to attach titles to PS1/PS2 serials

sources.name: VitaHEX HexFlow covers

sources.name: Personal local cover copies (PS1, PS2, Libretro platforms)
sources.rightsMode: USER_LOCAL_ONLY: publisher artwork kept in the git-ignored .local-only/ folder on the user's own machine; never committed, deployed or synced
sources.imageMode: local files served by the dev and preview servers at /__rupa-local/covers/
sources.notes: The way to have PS2 and similar covers offline without publishing them.

sources.name: manami-project/anime-offline-database
sources.rightsMode: ODbL 1.0 + DbCL 1.0 (share-alike, attribution); posters are not licensed for mirroring
sources.notes: Chosen over the cedya77 fork, whose licence the GitHub API reports as NOASSERTION.

sources.notes: Ranked by sitelink count: the most widely documented 66-2,500 items per collection. A single query across several classes timed out (504); one query per class works.
